regulation.description: Unilever Plc and spice maker McCormick & Co.’s $44.8 billion deal faces an in depth investigation unless the firms offer remedies to allay the watchdog’s competition concerns.

regulation.title: Korea Fines Bond Dealers Record $1.2 Billion Over Collusion
regulation.description: South Korea’s antitrust regulator imposed a record 1.63 trillion won ($1.2 billion) fine on more than a dozen domestic banks and brokerages for colluding in sovereign bond auctions, exposing a yearslong practice that undermined competition and raised the government’s borrowing costs.
